structured.feedback: The description is about 190 words in Markdown with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the listing, and it leaves out the drying complaint, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the loose feature/benefit split and "soft, easy to manage" and "feel healthier", which the listing doesn't support.
